retrieval_policy.kickoff_dependency_policy: The kickoff must remain completable from the local manager-authored packet and a local C toolchain; unverified external records are not dependencies.
future_job_rules: Retrieve only within an explicitly authorized, bounded resource scope.
Never bypass authentication, paywalls, authorization checks, robots restrictions, or license terms.
Preserve the supplied URL and separately record redirects, access result, retrieval time, content checksum, and source provenance.
Classify licensing, learner visibility, solution risk, and official-unit granularity before storing or promoting content.
Retain honest failure evidence; a failed or blocked retrieval remains unavailable rather than being inferred present.
Do not retrieve, expose, or use published project solutions, hidden graders, sealed references, or another learner's work.
retrieval_policy.student_view_rule: Only material explicitly cleared as learner-safe may enter a student view.
retrieval_policy.promotion_gate: A normalized record may become a planned official unit only after its content, identity, access, license, provenance, and validation status are established by a later authorized job.
